subject.title: fix(infra): use || for empty socket path/token fallback in mergeExecApprovalsSocketDefaults

question: Should the merge helper deliberately defend against raw, out-of-contract blank socket values, or should this PR be declined because all supported setters already normalize them?
rationale: The source establishes that the reported path is not reachable through current callers, while choosing a separate defensive contract for an authorization socket is an owner decision.

options.title: Decline the redundant fallback
options.body: Recommended: retain the normalized-input contract and close or withdraw the patch unless a supported caller demonstrates a real failure.

options.title: Adopt defense in depth
options.body: Keep the truthy fallback only with an explicit helper contract and a test showing the approved raw-input entry point that needs it.

recommendation.title: Decline the redundant fallback
recommendation.body: Recommended: retain the normalized-input contract and close or withdraw the patch unless a supported caller demonstrates a real failure.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this area to the normalize-then-merge caller design.
